moves.name: Fake Out
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: 40
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 3
Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: 120
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.description:
Dark (Physical)
Base Power: 70
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 1
Fails if the target did not select a physical attack, special attack, or Me First for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.

moves.name: Hammer Arm
moves.description:
Fighting (Physical)
Base Power: 100
Accuracy: 90
Priority: 0
Lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage.

moves.name: Ice Punch
moves.description:
Ice (Physical)
Base Power: 75
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.description:
Fighting (Physical)
Base Power: 75
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.description:
Fighting (Physical)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
This move's power is 20 if the target weighs less than 10 kg, 40 if less than 25 kg, 60 if less than 50 kg, 80 if less than 100 kg, 100 if less than 200 kg, and 120 if greater than or equal to 200 kg.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description:
Dark (Physical)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: 85
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

items.name: Kangaskhanite
items.description: If held by a Kangaskhan, this item allows it to Mega Evolve in battle.

abilities.name: Parental Bond
abilities.description: This Pokemon's damaging moves become multi-hit moves that hit twice. The second hit has its damage quartered. Does not affect Doom Desire, Dragon Darts, Dynamax Cannon, Endeavor, Explosion, Final Gambit, Fling, Future Sight, Ice Ball, Rollout, Self-Destruct, any multi-hit move, any move that has multiple targets, or any two-turn move.
